## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Raise model error categories like `ModelRateLimitError` from embedding models by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10804
* Add `usage_limits`, `deadline`, `run_id` and `conversation_id` to `ModelSelectionContext` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10856
* Default `BedrockConverseModel`'s `maxTokens` to Claude's maximum output, streaming such requests behind the scenes by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10845
* Deprecate `RetryPromptPart` in favor of `ToolReturnPart(outcome='retried')` and `RetryFeedbackPart` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8094
* Summarize harness-added user-channel content as `<harness_data>` instead of user messages in `SummarizingCompaction` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10833
* Give `AskUser`, `ConversationSearch`, `Macroscope`, `ManagedPrompt`, `PlaywrightBrowser` and `PydanticAIDocs` a stable default `id`, and append `ManagedPrompt` version changes by @DouweM in https
